typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsFXVolumeDailyArchive_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADEVOLUME as integer,
		MONTH1 as string,
		PORT as string,
		YEAR as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		AsofDate as string,
		SPOTFWDIND as string,
		CURRENCYBASEAMOUNT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblOpicsFXVolumeDailyStaging
tblOpicsFXVolumeDailyStaging sink(input(
		TRADEVOLUME as integer,
		MONTH1 as string,
		PORT as string,
		YEAR as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		AsofDate as string,
		SPOTFWDIND as string,
		CURRENCYBASEAMOUNT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TRADEVOLUME,
		MONTH1,
		PORT,
		YEAR,
		PRODUCT,
		Loaddate,
		AsofDate,
		SPOTFWDIND,
		CURRENCYBASEAMOUNT),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsFXVolumeDailyArchive_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsFXVolumeDailyArchive
